name: 聴聞の通知を公示する方法を変更
summary: 現在、聴聞の通知を公示する際は、行政機関の事務所の掲示場に掲示します。改正後は、規則で定める方法で広く見られる状態にし、事務所での掲示か、備え付けの端末での表示も行います。2026年5月21日以降に行う通知から適用します。
changes: 聴聞の通知内容を、規則で定める方法で広く見られるようにする
事務所では、掲示か備え付けの端末での表示を行う
通知が届いたとみなすまでの2週間を、公示の措置を始めた日から数える
who: 聴聞の通知が公示される人
why: 行政手続法の改正を踏まえ、聴聞の通知方法などを改めるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how hearing notices are made public
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, notices of hearings are made public by posting them on bulletin boards at administrative offices. After the amendment, the notice will be made widely accessible by a method set out in rules, and will also be posted at the office or displayed on a terminal provided there. This applies to notices issued on or after May 21, 2026.
changes: Make the contents of hearing notices widely accessible by a method set out in rules
Post the notice at the office or display it on a terminal provided there
Count the two-week period until a notice is deemed delivered from the day the public-notice measures begin
who: People whose hearing notices are made public
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the methods for notifying people of hearings and other matters are being revised in light of amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act.
